description: Expanded DNS-based device fingerprinting: covers iOS/Android/desktops, all major phone vendors (Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo/Huawei/OnePlus/Realme), wearables (Garmin/Fitbit/Apple Watch/Oura/WHOOP), smart-home (Hue/LIFX/Nanoleaf/Govee/Roomba/Roborock/Eufy/August/Yale/Schlage), security cameras (Blink/Ezviz/Tapo/Lorex/Swann/SimpliSafe/Vivint/Annke), TVs (Roku/Vizio/Hisense/TCL/Philips/Sharp), consoles (Xbox Series/PS5/Quest/Shield), printers (HP/Canon/Brother/Epson/Lexmark/Kyocera/Ricoh/Konica Minolta), POS (Square/Toast/Clover/Stripe Terminal/SumUp), vehicles (Tesla/BMW/Ford/Toyota/Honda/Hyundai/Kia/Audi/VW/Volvo/Mercedes/Nissan/Polestar/Rivian).

rules: Iterate over fingerprints in order; first match with score >= threshold wins.
A signature domain matches if it appears as a suffix of any of the device's DNS queries.
Patterns marked with `regex: true` are treated as Python re patterns (case-insensitive).
